audience: Dutch and Belgian entrepreneurs and accountants who send invoices from WeFact

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and the amount outstanding
useCases.text: List invoices by status or date range. Open one to read its lines, paid amount and outstanding amount.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their details
useCases.text: List customers with a search term or customer group. Open one for its address, VAT number and contacts.

useCases.title: Check products and their VAT rates
useCases.text: List products and services with their price excluding VAT and VAT rate. Open one for its description and price period.

useCases.title: Review active subscriptions and next invoice dates
useCases.text: List the recurring subscriptions, active by default, with customer, product, price and next invoice date.
